name: Question 2
problem:
Consider the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}5 & -2 \\ -1 & 4\end{aligned}].$ You're given that ${\lambda }_{1}=3$ and ${\lambda }_{2}=6$ are the eigenvalues of $A$, and
${v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$, ${v}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1\end{aligned}]$ are the respective eigenvectors. Find the matrices $P$ and $D$ such that $PD{P}^{-1}=A,$ where $D$ is a diagonal matrix.
